messages:
olivia_sales: QuantumApps POC just hit a wall — multiple 429s during a load step at ~11:03 PT. They were running 4 parallel sessions with large responses. Can eng/ops help? @raj_se @sam_ops

raj_se: Which model and response sizes? Any streaming enabled? Do we have a sample error blob?

olivia_sales: They said model=redwood-xt-8k, max_tokens=1000, stream=false. Attached client error: HTTP 429 with retry_after_ms=2000 and X-RateLimit-Remaining=0.

sam_ops: Pulling gateway metrics. One sec.

sam_ops: Gateway shows tenant-level burst bucket exhausted. Their trial tier burst cap is 800k tokens/min; per-route cap for /v1/generate is 300k tokens/min. With 4 concurrents at 1k tokens each we saturate the window pretty fast.

raj_se: Two quick customer-facing options: reduce max_tokens to 250 + enable streaming; or request a temporary per-route bump for the demo. Which is easier for them now?

olivia_sales: They prefer not to truncate outputs for the demo. Can ops do a short bump (a few hours)?

sam_ops: We can apply a 3-hour manual bump to 1M tokens/min for their tenant. Need explicit customer approval and ops ticket. I'll create change and hold pending confirmation.

ratebot: Ops change request created: CI-4808. Change will apply per-route tokens/min update pending approval.

raj_se: Also recommend they implement client-side backoff on 429 to avoid retry storms. Quick pseudocode:
```
if (resp.status == 429) {
  sleep(resp.headers['retry_after_ms'] || 1000);
  retry();
}
```

olivia_sales: Customer approves the bump. Please go ahead. They start demo in ~15m.

sam_ops: Applying change now. Change ID CHG-7818. New /v1/generate cap = 1000000 tokens/min for tenant quantumapps-9.

ratebot: Change CHG-7818 applied. Monitor X-RateLimit-* headers for pre/post.

sam_ops: Tailing gateway logs for 20m. So far no 429s in their request stream. I'll keep watching and report anomalies.

raj_se: I'll send them a short guide: switch to streaming, add prefix caching, and consider Dedicated if they need sustained concurrency.

olivia_sales: Thanks all — will update the customer and close the loop after the demo. :rocket:
